applicability: Curator hand-off entries admitted through the ordinary curator writer that would write new realization claims.
conditions: A converted file-writer handoff is parsed for realization targets before authoring its record and sidecar edits.
The converted file writer admits one whole hand-off operation under MIK-R12@v2 rule 4; entry-local diagnostics do not authorize partial file writes.
Earlier per-entry sibling commits are historical-mode behavior only while that earlier path exists, never a fallback for converted handoffs.
exclusions: Target shapes that are not JSON objects, which the target-shape check refuses separately.
Stored historical claims; this parser judges supplied targets rather than re-admitting every stored row.
statement: For an entry that would write new realizations, a non-null non-string rationale or role at either level is reported as realization_value_not_text, an unknown nonblank role (absent included) as realization_role_unknown, and an effective rationale longer than PROSE_MAX_LENGTH as realization_rationale_too_long. Null/missing values are unstated and resolve through target/entry defaults; absent effective rationale separately refuses. Diagnostics name the entry and offending targets before identity minting. A converted violation refuses the whole handoff with no writes; sibling commits are earlier-path provenance only.
